annotations.text:
Direction: elevation by surface step, not shadow.

On #000 OLED black a drop shadow is invisible. Depth comes from #000 → #161616 → #1f1f1f plus 1px #2c2c2e hairlines. Same tokens as the app today — nothing new invented.

Typography: system font, tabular numerals.

The app is almost entirely numbers. tabular-nums stops digits jittering as values change. Display drops 40→64px only for the one hero number; everything else tightens to 28/20/16/13/11 with −0.02em on headings.

Spacing: grouping, not an even stack.

8px within a group, 24px between related blocks, 32px between sections. The old screen used 16px everywhere, which is why it read as one undifferentiated column.

Unchanged and non-negotiable:

No red anywhere — over-target renders identically to under-target. Confidence stays visible as weight and opacity, never a traffic light. Expenditure is always a range. ~ marks an estimated figure. These are engine-integrity rules, not styling.
